description: 180 Degrees Consulting at UCI is the world's largest university-based social impact consultancy. We provide socially conscious organizations around the world with high quality, pro bono consulting services. The branch at UCI is primarily dedicated to help socially conscious organizations in and around Orange County.

Brian, also a college student, had been experiencing depression and psychosis for three years but had concealed his symptoms from everyone around him. description: Acts College Ministry is a college fellowship that aims to love God and to love people. Acts College ministry is comprised of a network of cell groups on different campuses throughout Orange County, meeting throughout the week. A cell group is where honest friendship, Bible study, sermon discussions, constant prayer, and compassionate care are emphasized. It is within these dynamic cell groups where the core of our evangelism and discipleship take place.

description: Acts2Fellowship is an undergraduate Christian fellowship that welcomes students from all walks of life and backgrounds. We hope to be a place where we learn that the Bible is relevant and personal, and the claims of God are not mere stories but personal realities. We also hope to be a home-away-from-home! We meet as a group for weekly Bible studies, usually on Fridays, to learn what the Bible says about our lives. Along the way, we eat good food, have fun together, and have times to answer timeless questions while building up a sense of family in our group.

name: Actuarial Society at UC Irvine

description: ABSM @ UC Irvine is a student run initiative with a mission to empower Black students on UC Irvine’s campus by equipping them with the necessary skills to thrive in their academic & healthcare aspirations. By dismantling obstacles faced by Black students and fostering connections with diverse medical pathways, we aim to revolutionize the journey to healthcare.

name: Advisory Council on Campus Climate, Culture and Inclusion

It is our hope that Aerodynamix A Cappella makes music that inspires, entertains and impacts.

You can get a glimpse of us on our Instagram @alphaomegaoc or contact us for more information!

description: Alzheimer's Buddies at UCI (ABUI) is a volunteer organization open to students interested in interacting with and forming relationships with individuals who have Alzheimer's disease living in memory care facilities. Volunteers will have the opportunity to interact 1-on-1 with a buddy through activities and conversation.

name: Amateur Radio Association at UCI - ARA
description: The Amateur Radio Association @ UCI (ARA @ UCI) is a public service and hobby club created to serve current licensed and prospective amateur radio enthusiasts on and around campus. The purpose and objectives of ARA @ UCI are: To promote, educate and participate in traditional radio activities of Amateur radio. To provide a communications capability and technical knowledge for the community, especially in times of emergency. To promote social interaction and cooperation among our members and other enthusiasts in the community.

name: American Academy of Environmental Engineers and Scientists at UCI
description: The American Academy of Environmental Engineers and Scientists (AAEES) Student Chapter at the University of California, Irvine is a professional student organization dedicated to preparing its members for successful careers in environmental engineering and science. description: The American Indian Student Association (A.I.S.A.) was founded in 1974. Initially providing a comfortable environment for Native American Students and Faculty in addition to promoting awareness to the campus community by sharing our cultural heritage. All UCI students are welcome.

We want to promote the decentralized way of distributing data among a large audience and show how blockchain can be used in a variety of fields. We want to bridge this gap between the industry and student population through opportunities for our members such as workshops, educational seminars, hackathons, conferences, and networking events so everyone benefits from blockchain. name: Blum Center for Poverty Alleviation
description: The UCI Blum Center for Poverty Alleviation's mission is to promote social change and inspire the next generation of leaders to action with research on poverty alleviation. By collaborating across disciplines with students, faculty and practitioners, the UCI Blum Center rigorously explores systemic, geopolitical, technological and climate forces affecting poverty. The UCI Blum Center's innovative education programs, basic and applied research, and work in community development and policy-making engage future leaders to reduce the risks of poverty for vulnerable populations and improve humanity

name: Book Club at UCI
description: The Book Club at UCI aims to facilitate meaningful connections through our shared love for books. We hope to hold quarterly book readings, discussions, and events (social, community service, etc) that will enrich our lives as students. Reading holds different values in different lives– hobby, passion, career, creative relief, therapy– and this club seeks to create a safe space for each.

name: Books Through Bars
description: Our mission is to provide reading materials to readers in prisons across the United States. We hope that each book we send out reaches someone who aspires to improve their well-being and contribute to others around them with emotional, social, and professional knowledge.

name: Bowling at UCI
description: Eager to level up your Bowling skills? Have a desire to knock down some pins as a hobby? Need an excuse to take a break from academics and hang out with friends? Join us for some games at Bowling at UCI! Whether you rarely bowl or are a professional bowler with multiple 300-point games, we hope to create the space for your to not only develop your skills but also play with other bowlers at UCI. Follow us at @bowlingatuci on Instagram to learn more. Happy bowling!

name: Boxing Club at UCI
description: Boxing Club at UCI is affiliated with UCI Club Sports and we compete in the National Collegiate Boxing Association. Our club seeks to provide the UCI community with an engaging and applicable way to stay in shape while forming connections with others. Whether you're an experienced boxer or a beginner looking to stay fit, Boxing Club at UCI will challenge you and give you the opportunity to create bonds.

name: Brain Exercise Initiative at UCI
description: We are a chapter of the Brain Exercise Initiative, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that uses simple math, writing and reading-aloud exercises as an intervention to improve cognitive function in those with Alzheimer's Disease.

name: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Club at UCI
description: Purpose/Mission Statement * The purpose of the Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Club at UCI is to provide an easy-going social environment that gives undergraduate students an introduction to the techniques of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. * No experience is necessary to become a part of this organization, but as a member of the organization you will receive professional hands-on experience. * This organization is driven by the passion and motivation of its members. name: Brick Theatre Company
description: Brick Theatre Company aims to support and uplift the intersectional voices of the LGBTQ+ community through theatre. We strive to facilitate the creation of new works that truthfully represent the diverse voices in our community. We will maintain an open dialogue with our audiences so that we can educate and build connections that will uplift all of us. We strive to ignite passion and compassion in ourselves and our audiences. We strive to become a welcoming home and expression of love and pride for all LGBTQ+ students on campus.

name: Bridges International at UCI
description: Bridges International at UCI is a club dedicated to serving international students at UCI. We are a group started by Christians to help International students adjust and feel at home in Irvine. Our motto is providing a "Home Away from Home" through a weekly English conversation program, Friday night dinners, fun events, and other spiritual resources.

name: BridgeUSA at UCI
description: Our mission is to counter the growing division and polarization by encouraging thoughtful conversations that prioritize respect, humility, and empathy. We aim to create an inclusive environment where all perspectives are welcomed and heard, as long as they are presented with civility and care.

name: Bridging The Gap at UCI - BTG
description: Our primary goal is to bridge the gap between socioeconomically disadvantaged students and careers in healthcare and research through an empowering culture of mentorship and service.

name: Brown Bag Theatre Company
description: Brown Bag Theater Company is an ensemble of artists & scholars who aim to produce equally engaging & captivating artistic work that reflects & empowers the Latinx communities. We create various opportunities for young Latinx individuals, and our allies, within the performing arts. At BBTC, we believe that the discipline of theatre is a cultural force capable of transforming our community and we bolster this belief whilst celebrating the richness & pride of Latinx culture.

name: built at uci
description: The purpose of built @uci is to provide an inclusive environment where students can explore their interests and strengthen their skills in any area they're passionate about, from crafting and design to technical building and problem-solving, through community meetings, workshops, and collaborative projects.

name: Burmese Student Association at UCI
description: The organization, Burmese Student Associate (BURSA) at UCI, is dedicated to the celebration of Burmese culture as well as to creating a welcoming and supportive space for Burmese students. The organization aims to share Burmese culture and spread awareness of current events of the country within the University as well as the greater Los Angeles area. BURSA will allow the opportunity for students to engage in social, cultural, and community-service-based activities.

name: Business Careers in Entertainment Club at UCI
description: The Business Careers in Entertainment Club (BCEC) at UC Irvine was established during the Winter quarter of 2018. BCEC is designed to help students explore and prepare for careers in the entertainment industry. We're open to students of all majors, providing them with the professional development opportunities and network necessary to competitively pursue a career in entertainment. name: Business Law Society at UCI Law
description: The Business Law Society (BLS) is dedicated to bridging the gap between law students and the corporate and business sectors of the legal profession. The organization focuses on expanding professional networking opportunities by fostering connections with law firms, in-house counsel, and bar associations. BLS also aims to collaborate with other graduate programs and student organizations to host interdisciplinary events that promote the exchange of ideas and the development of meaningful professional relationships. In addition, the organization is committed to cultivating leadership skills and

name: By Any Means at UCI
description: By Any Means (B.A.M.) is an organization dedicated to enriching the lives of the homeless by any means possible. We will cater to individual homeless shelters' unique needs, including supplying volunteers for particular programs or internships, collecting donations in the form of food, drink, or items and delivering donations to the shelters, and more. By Any Means will provide opportunities for volunteers to raise awareness for the homeless community, participate in/plan club events, and work with other organizations dedicated to helping the homeless.

name: Cal Animage Epsilon (formerly Anime Club-Cal Animage Epsilon)
description: To enrich students of UC Irvine with the language, culture and animation of Japan. And to unite people with similar interests in Japanese Animation.

name: California Initiative for Health Equity and Action
description: The California Initiative for Health Equity and Action (Cal-IHEA) is a state-wide research and policy center that supports the translation of research evidence into state health policy and public health practice to improve health equity in California.

name: CALPIRG - California Public Interest Research Group at UCI
description: Students have the power to shape the future we will inherit. We work with professional staff at colleges and universities to make sure our peers have the skills, opportunities and training they need to create a better, more sustainable future for all of us. Our chapters provide the training, professional support and resources students need to tackle climate change, protect public health, revitalize our democracy, feed the hungry and more. name: CalTeach at UCI
description: The CalTeach Advisory Board recruits and cultivates community across and within cohorts to foster the collective well-being of future equity-focused teachers.

name: Cambodian Awareness Organization at UCI
description: The Cambodian Awareness Organization at UCI is a group dedicated to bringing Cambodia and its culture to the forefront of public thought. We celebrate multiculturalism and diversity among members. With a focus on social networking, leadership skill development, and volunteer experience, CAO encourages community involvement as we seek to reach people both at home and abroad. In addition, we are building bridges among Cambodian student organizations throughout Southern California.

name: Camp Kesem
description: Camp Kesem provides a summer camp to kids whose parents have been affected by cancer through the support of student-run campaigns. Kesem is a nationwide community, driven by passionate college student leaders, that supports children through and beyond their parents cancer. Kesem is the largest national organization dedicated to supporting children impacted by a parent's cancer at no cost to families. Our innovative and fun-filled programs provide children with peers who understand their unique needs and create long-lasting impacts.

name: CampMed at UCI
description: CampMed at UCI aspires to inspire students who face low socioeconomic barriers to pursue higher education by providing exposure to undergraduate mentors, UC Irvine faculty, as well as healthcare professionals. CampMed at UCI is a student-run high school outreach program that was founded by UCI medical and undergraduate students in 1997. There was an increasing need for a local program that would target socio-economically disadvantaged high school students interested in pursuing higher education, particularly in the health science fields. Currently in its 27th year of existence, CampMed at UCI

name: Campus Planning & Sustainability
description: The mission of Campus Planning & Sustainability is to plan the use and physical character of campus land and its overall environment in order to maximize the use of campus land resources in support of the university's mission.

name: Cancer Research Institute
description: To share events sponsored by the Cancer Research Institute, an organized research unit in the Office of Research, with the students. The CRI also lists community events on behalf of the Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center.

name: Cards at UCI
description: Cards at UCI is dedicated to fostering a fun, inclusive community where students can learn, play, and connect through card and board games. Our mission is to introduce new card games, teach essential concepts in probability and statistics through gameplay, and create a relaxed social space for card enthusiasts to unwind from academic life.

name: CareTech
description: CareTech is committed to advancing healthcare through the development of innovative applications designed for early disease detection, utilizing cutting-edge technologies and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to leverage the collective expertise of UCI students to create impactful solutions that significantly enhance healthcare outcomes.

name: Cariño Student Outreach Clinic (formerly Outreach Clinic at UC Irvine)
description: Cariño Student Outreach Clinic is a non-denominational organization that is committed to delivering high-quality medical care to individuals who have limited access to health services and insurance. We moved our operation to The HUB OC Resource Center to better serve the Santa Ana, Orange and neighboring communities. We strive to provide comprehensive care to our patients by offering health care services, wellness education, social services, basic medications, referrals, and, if they are eligible, assistance in obtaining health care coverage. name: Catalyst Undergraduate Art Gallery
description: Catalyst Undergraduate Art Gallery is an undergraduate-run gallery in which motivated students of any major may display their artwork while also gaining curatorial experience. Catalyst strives to promote budding artists' careers and to create opportunities for students to share art and culture with the campus at large.

name: Cellular & Molecular Biosciences
description: The PhD program in Cellular & Molecular Biosciences at UC Irvine provides ideal training to launch the careers of talented researchers in diverse fields of biomedicine. With a multi-cultural student cohort, we strive to fulfill the dreams of students from many different backgrounds. The training environment is rigorous, but also cognizant of the need in life for a supportive and balanced lifestyle.

name: Celtic Law Society at UCI Law
description: The purpose of this organization is to create an inclusive community for students interested in law and legal careers while exploring the intersection of law, justice, and Celtic history and values. The Celtic Law Society promotes academic engagement, professional development, mentorship, and service, and is open to all students regardless of background or heritage.

name: Center for Black Cultures, Resources & Research
description: The mission of the Center for Black Cultures, Resources, and Research (CBCRR) is to provide a just, safe, vibrant, inclusive, culturally supportive, and socio-ecologically sustainable space for Black Students, Faculty, and Staff. A home away from home where Black students can thrive and reach for their highest potential and hopefully discover their genius. name: Center for Digital Transformation
description: The Center for Digital Transformation is a Center of Excellence at The Paul Merage School of Business at the University of California, Irvine. The Center (CDT) conducts and disseminates research on digital transformation. As a university-based center, it focuses on educating the workforce for success in a technology-intensive world.

name: Center for Epigenetics and Metabolism
description: The Center for Epigenetics and Metabolism (CEM) brings together researchers at UCI interested in epigenetics, chromatin remodeling and cellular metabolism by fostering research interactions, developing novel strategies, and informing the UCI community of the remarkable developments in the field. The CEM creates a physical, intellectual and organizational environment for the study of epigenetics and the relationship with cellular metabolism. The CEM has privileged relationships with other Centers of Epigenetics in Southern California.

name: Center for Excellence in Writing & Communication (Writing Center)
description: The Center for Excellence in Writing & Communication (The Writing Center) is a free resource for undergraduate and graduate students to get feedback on any writing from peer tutors and professional writing specialists.

name: Center for Investment and Wealth Management
description: The Center for Investment and Wealth Management is dedicated to providing students at UCI with the financial literacy skills they need to succeed in life.

name: Center for Neuropolitics
description: The Center for Neuropolitics contributes to the ongoing political dialogues by engaging the multi-disciplinary expertise of neuroscience, political science, neurology, psychiatry, psychology, and philosophy.

name: Center for Research on Teacher Development and Professional Practice (CRT)
description: The Education Center for Research on Teacher Development and Professional Practice (CRT) in the School of Education at the University of California, Irvine fosters collaborations among faculty, students, and practitioners on projects focused on a variety of aspects of teacher development and learning and on the study of teaching and teacher professional practice and of the systems in which these are embedded (including school and district leadership).

name: Center For Student Wellness & Health Promotion
description: We strive to be a leader in collegiate health promotion by focusing on the unique and relevant health needs and concerns of UCI students to support their academic success. We empower students to make informed decisions to support individual health and a healthy campus environment by providing comprehensive programs and coordinated services revolving around sexual and relationship health, alcohol and other drugs, diet and nutrition, emotional well-being, and overall wellness.

name: Center for the Neurobiology of Learning and Memory
description: The Center for the Neurobiology of Learning and Memory at UC Irvine is directed by Michael A. Yassa. It is the first institute in the world dedicated to the study of learning and memory. In 35 years since it was first established in 1983 by the UC Regents, with James L. McGaugh as its Founding Director, it has significantly transformed our understanding of the brain and how it stores information. name: Central Asian Student Association at UC Irvine
description: The mission of the Central Asian Student Association (CASA) at UC Irvine is to create unity among students from Central Asian backgrounds by fostering our shared cultural heritage while building deep and lasting connections. CASA strives to represent the voices of Central Asian students officially within UCI and beyond. Our purpose is to celebrate and preserve the unique traditions, history, and values of Central Asia through diverse activities that connect members to one another and to the broader academic and cultural community. name: Chabad at UCI
description: The primary purpose of Chabad at UCI is to provide an inclusive space for students at the University of California, Irvine to explore their Judaic roots within the framework of traditional Judaism. Our objectives include but are not limited to; educational, ritual, and social activities, in addition to counseling and spiritual guidance to individual students.

name: Chancellor's Excellence Scholars
description: Through a collaborative effort between Student Success Initiatives (SSI) and campus partners, the Chancellor's Excellence and Promise Scholars Program aims to support the advancement and holistic development of its students. Education partnerships make up a cohort of students, consisting of first-year students and transfers, who will receive support through intentional programming and advising to meet their academic, personal, and professional needs as they make their transition into UC Irvine.

name: Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center

Discover To facilitate and promote interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary cancer research across UCI. name: Charitable Humanitarian Acts Society at UCI - CHASO
description: CHASO is built upon the foundations of community and philanthropy. By uniting healthcare, business, and art under a common cause, we strive to provide resources for those underserved and raise awareness to societal issues. This chapter at UCI will focus on upbringing and highlighting small businesses nearby, while also connecting networks of current and past Anteaters to fundraise for the greater good.

name: Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences
description: The mission of the Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences is to create new knowledge about biological processes and principles, to disseminate this information by educating students about factual knowledge and the experience of discovery, and to contribute to the public discussion about the nature and role of science in society. Research within the school encompasses all levels of biological organization, from molecular and biochemical to global biological processes. It encompasses both fundamental discovery and application in areas beneficial to society.

name: Chemistry Club at UCI
description: The Chemistry Club at UCI aims to provide support for undergraduates at the University of California, Irvine, interested in the chemical sciences; we will promote scholarship, instill a mindset of career professionalism, emphasize the value of outreach, and build a community of individuals who will bond and grow—personally, academically, and professionally—in the field of chemistry.

name: Chi Rho Omicron Inc - XPO
description: The mission of Chi Rho Omicron shall be to promote the understanding, enrichment, and appreciation of the Pilipino culture, history, and heritage through a brotherhood/family environment. To instill the desire for self-improvement, scholastic excellence, and the cultivation of civic responsibility.

name: Chicano/Latino Staff Association
description: "The Chicano/Latino Staff Association at UCI shall assist the University in the recruitment and retention of Chicano/Latino undergraduate and graduate students. It shall support the Chicano/Latino campus community by: (1)providing a social support network for Chicano/Latino staff and students; (2) serving as an advocacy group for the Chicano/Latino campus community; (3) encouraging and promoting the hiring and retention of Chicano/Latino staff at UCI; and (4) advocating and developing educational and social programs for staff at UCI."

name: Chicanos/Latinos for Community Medicine
description: Our mission is to cultivate an inclusive community of Latinx and underrepresented students committed to addressing health disparities through service, education, and advocacy for underserved populations by fostering a diverse network.

name: Chinese Alumni Association at UCI
description: Our organization aims to bridge the gap between incoming Chinese Anteaters and Chinese Alumni, who are willing to help students who studied abroad for the first time. By organizing workshops, group activities, and bonding events, we will hone students' life skills in living in the United States and achieving their pursuits. If you want to join a warm and supportive family, the Chinese Alumni Association is your best choice!

name: Chinese Association (CAUCI)
description: We, the members of the Chinese Association at the University of California-Irvine, establish this constitution to govern such matters as are within the jurisdiction of this organization. The purpose of CAUCI shall be threefold: a ) To increase the awareness of Chinese culture among club members/ associates and the general community; b ) To promote social interactions and understanding among members; c ) To be of service to the campus as well as surrounding community.

name: Chinese Dance & Ballet Fusion at UCI
description: We are dedicated to blending the grace of Chinese dance with the elegance of ballet, uniting the artistic essence of East and West. Through movement, we transcend cultural boundaries, fostering a community where tradition meets innovation, and every dancer finds their unique expression.

name: Chinese Law Student Society
description: The purpose of this organization is to create a diverse learning environment and network for Chinese and other international students, facilitate conversations and promote awareness of Chinese-related laws and regulations, and assist member students and alumni in their career development.

name: Chinese Orchestra at UC Irvine
description: Our organization intends to foster the love for Chinese traditional music through performances, collaborations and outreach. We wish to provide an open, supportive environment where students of all backgrounds can grow their skills, share their knowledge, and contribute to the multicultural fabric of UCI. We wish to share the experience of Chinese traditional music and explore its nexus with modern/western music.

name: Chinese Students and Scholars Association (CSSA)
description: CSSA is an organization that helps Chinese students and scholars in the aspects of daily life, career development in the U.S. Ourselves, members of CSSA-UCI, are a group of Chinese students and scholars who are full of passion and enthusiasm for exploring the way to building deep communication channels between Chinese and other cultures and groups at UCI. We want to build well organized community in which people with different nationalities have mutual understanding in culture identity.

name: Chinese Union
description: Chinese Union (CU at UCI) is a registered student organization at UCI founded by international students. we have been dedicated to serving the Chinese student community and supporting international students. CU at UCI focuses on charity work, volunteer opportunities, and fostering cultural exchange within the campus community. CU provides valuable resources and networking opportunities for students. We hope that everyone can get great experience and valuable memory with CUCS.

name: Christian Legal Society Student Chapter at UCI School of Law (formerly Christian Law Students Association)

name: Christian Students

We hope that the club would serve as a gathering point for all students who are interested in pursuing the truth in the Bible and having fellowship with other students. We also organize other club activities to strengthen the bonds between members and to contribute to the overall atmosphere of student well-being and rapport on campus. If you are looking for a club that combines school life with spiritual life, then we invite you to join us!

name: Cine-Collective
description: Our mission is to encourage people to be familiar with what film has to offer and how to do it ourselves as well. We wish to explore every facet of the film industry while stimulating creativity on campus. We seek to establish a presence on campus that encourages all students to get involved in film discussion, understanding, and their production. This is a place for all people to engage/learn about how to make films together.

name: Circle K International at UCI
description: Circle K International (CKI) is a collegiate community service organization spanning the globe. We pursue our three tenets: service, leadership, and fellowship as we serve others. Circle K provides its members the opportunity to engage in communities both local and distant, with various colleges collaborating on projects across borders (often state and sometimes national) on a frequent basis. name: Circle of Fifths
description: Circle of Fifths is a student-run a cappella group that creates a space for members to join together and sing. Prioritizing showmanship and brotherhood, Circle of Fifths is a group whose energy and closeness are reflected closely in their performances. Circle of Fifths performs at club events on campus and outside events to which they are invited, and provides a space for tenor & bass singers to create memorable music. In addition to performance, Circle of Fifths also competes in competitions.

name: Civil & Environmental Engineering
description: Our mission is to provide students with a broad, fundamental and flexible educational program and to expand engineering knowledge through an active and exciting undergraduate and graduate research program. The department is dedicated to providing life-long development, instilling a sense of professional responsibility, and serving our society. We provide an environment that promotes teamwork and values integrity and honesty in all efforts. Civil and environmental engineering is an inherently interdisciplinary field. description: The association's mission is to promote unity among CEE graduate students through social events, and advance their academic and professional interests. name: Clair De Lune A Cappella
description: Clair de Lune (CDL) A Cappella is an all-treble voice a cappella group at the University of California, Irvine. CDL is composed of members from various ethnicities, social classes, and levels of musical proficiency who come together to share their love for music and performance both on and off campus. We prioritize inclusivity and are a fully functioning support system for one another and strive to motivate each member to flourish musically as we become more confident in finding our voice as individuals, as well as in the ensemble!

name: Claire Trevor School of the Arts
description: As UC Irvine's creative laboratory, the Claire Trevor School of the Arts explores and presents the arts as the essence of human experience and expression, through art forms ranging from the most traditional to the radically new. Our international and distinguished faculty work across a wide variety of art forms, partnering with others across the campus; our nationally ranked programs in art, dance, drama, and music begin with training but end in original invention.

name: Climate Resilience Club
description: Our mission is to promote meditative and mindfulness practices through a deep connection with the environment. We aim to facilitate collective action to address climate issues by organizing community cleanups, local initiatives, and environmental advocacy throughout the year to increase community ecological sustainability. Further, we are committed to advancing environmental education beyond our organization by collaborating with local climate change coalitions and field experts to educate our surrounding community.

name: Climbing Club at UCI
description: Climbing Club at UCI is dedicated to promoting rock climbing within the UCI community. We achieve this by competing in the USA Climbing Collegiate Series at the local, regional and national level competitions. We offer outdoor trips, practices, training sessions, skill clinics, and information meetings so everyone has the opportunity to increase their rock climbing knowledge and skill level.

name: Club Baseball at UCI
description: Help improve members' skills by allowing each individual to compete at a high level. Develop friendships through the shared love of the game. Ensure members grow as teammates and individuals in order to cultivate success on and off the field. Make sure to follow us @uciclubbaseball for important information (tryouts, games, socials), or email us clubbasebalatuci@gmail.com with any questions!

name: Club Italia at UCI
description: To encourage students to not only learn more about Italian Culture and Language in an open environment, but also to engage students in study abroad opportunities and travel.

name: Club Roundnet at UCI (formerly Spikeball at UCI)
description: Club Roundnet at UCI is dedicated to fostering a vibrant community centered around the enjoyment and promotion of the game of Roundnet known more often as Spikeball. This club sport provides a place for competitive players to grow and compete against other colleges. As a part of the Spikeball College Tour series there will be two sectionals along with various other tournaments we will train for. The club consists of open pick up, competitive practices, clinics, exhibition matches, and national tournaments.

name: Club Softball at UCI
description: This club is a fastpitch softball team who competes around Southern California and parts of Arizona. Members have ranges of experience, but some experience is preferred due to the competitive level.

name: Cognitive Science Association
description: CSA aims to empower students interested in cognitive science by building a closer-knit community, making the Cognitive Science Department and research happening on campus more accessible.

name: College Democrats at UCI
description: College Democrats at UCI is dedicated to informing the student body about important political issues affecting our university, city, state, and country. We strive to foster intelligent political discussion and critical thinking on campus, connect students to their local communities and elected officials, and advance Democratic principles and policies of social, economic, and environmental justice.

name: Commit the Change

name: Common Ground Dance Team
description: Common Ground Dance Team is an organization at UCI that is dedicated to growing as dancers and people, inspiring others through our performances at UCI and non-UCI events. Our mission, "Valuing the importance of well-being, self-expression, and inclusion; we strive to empower one another as a means to cultivate appreciation for our individualities - and although we may create, move, and live in different ways, one thing is for sure: DANCING IS OUR COMMON GROUND."

name: Communication Club
description: Communication Club seeks to foster a cultural and language exchange between UCI students and International ESL students. Through weekly programming and the partnering of students, we aim to provide an outlet to these international ESL students to make their experience at UCI better and to practice their English with fluent speakers.

name: Community Health Alliance of UCI

Our organization provides structured community support through various community service initiatives.

description: CODEC is dedicated to making technology accessible while fostering a supportive, confident, and inclusive community for students interested in this field. We believe that a sense of belonging

name: Community Table at UCI (formerly Episcopal Campus Ministry at UCI (Canterbury Irvine))
description: The community table at UCI organization consists of a community of fellowship and service. We meet once a month to have a communal meal with the members of the organization during which we express any ups and downs that have happened in our lives with the goal of fostering a strong support system among members to enhance the college experience. name: Competitive Sports
description: Club Sports at UCI are student-initiated and student-managed clubs that provide opportunities in recreational and competitive activities of interest to the student body. Participating in club sports provides an outlet for competing in athletics or learning new recreational activities. The Club Sports program's purpose is to give all UCI students the opportunity to pursue specific sport and recreation activities with others who share a similar inter

description: Our mission is to allocate a space for artists and non-art majors to have a space to create art, learn about art, and be published in unjuried publications and exhibitions. The goals of our organization is to publish periodical print and digital publications unjuried, host an accessible gallery show of submitted artworks unjuried, and to build a community of artists that can create together and receive feedback from each other.

name: Consumer Law Organization
description: The mission of this organization is to: 1. educate UC Irvine students about consumer law issues as well as legal and legislative advocacy; 2. create networks between consumer law attorneys, advocacy organizations, and the UC Irvine student body; 3. foster community among student advocates whose interests intersect with consumer protection; and 4. promote consumer protection curriculum and clinics that provide training opportunities for students. 5. act as a direct liaison between CLASS and NACA and UC Irvine law school

name: Conte Center @ UCI
description: Addresses how early-life experiences influence the brain and contribute to vulnerability to mental illnesses starting during adolescence.

name: COPE Health Scholars
description: The purpose of the COPE Health Scholars Club is to educate, inspire, and support students pursuing careers in healthcare by providing opportunities for professional development, mentorship, leadership, and community engagement. The organization strives to create an inclusive environment where students can explore diverse healthcare professions, develop meaningful relationships with peers and professionals, gain exposure to clinical and service opportunities, and build the skills necessary for successful careers in healthcare. Additionally, the club serves as a platform for COPE Health Scholars

name: Coptic Orthodox Christian Club
description: To support fellowship on campus and to bring the experience of the Orthodox Christian Church through community life, prayer, service to others, and study of the Faith. Furthermore, Coptic Club @ UCI strives to nurture and strengthen love for Christ Jesus and His church in its fullness at this most critical juncture of life.

name: Cosmetic Chemist Society
description: The purpose of CCS is to promote research in the cosmetic industry to further the interests and recognition of aspiring cosmetic chemists. Through events and workshops, CCS will help students interested in the cosmetic industry to get connected with industry professionals, gain insight on and opportunities in the field, and learn about the chemical ingredients and their interactions in personal care products. CCS will be career and professionally focused, but the organization will also emphasize the creativity, educational, and social aspects of the cosmetic industry.

name: Create For Kids
description: At Create For Kids, we use the power of art to bring smiles to hospitalized children. We know that being in a hospital can be tough for kids and their families, which is why we provide a variety of creative activities to make their stay a little brighter. We believe that art is a vital component of the healing process, and we strive to create a nurturing environment that promotes creativity and smiles. Our volunteers are passionate about their work and are dedicated to making a lasting impact on children's lives.

name: Creative Media Network at UCI
description: The CMN’s mission is to foster a collaborative environment in which filmmakers, actors, writers, photographers, and all persons interested in the creative process can connect with one another through a streamlined and accessible network. The CMN will serve as a community through which the creative process can be shared. The CMN is completely led by and for UCI students and will focus on catering to their creative efforts, but all CMN resources will be available to anyone regardless of experience or university affiliation. Our initial goals for the organization involve its inception as a websit

name: Creative Wellness Collective
description: The purpose of the organization is to provide a supportive and creative environment where individuals can explore art as a tool for personal growth, emotional healing, and self-expression. The club's mission is to foster mental and emotional well-being through artistic activities, workshops, lectures, and clinical experiences that allow participants to engage in a therapeutic process. In the short term, the organization aims to offer regular sessions that introduce various art forms, providing participants with space and guidance to express their emotions in a safe and non-judgmental setting.

name: Creative Writers Guild at UC Irvine
description: We are an organization that promotes and celebrates the processes of creative writing. We recognize the power of narrative in our culture, and our goal is to craft stories, poems, and films that matter.

name: Cricket Club at UCI
description: The Cricket Club at UCI plays and hosts the prestigious OCCA (Orange County Cricket Association) which involves the best cricket playing clubs in Orange County. The tournament is held in the Fall Quarter and Winter Quarter every year and played in the Twenty-20 overs format. We also play competitive bilateral series games against our arch rivals UC San Diego on non-league weekends.

description: Consistently ranked as one of the top programs in the nation, the Criminology, Law and Society PhD program focuses on the causes, manifestations and consequences of crime; the impacts of crime on society; social regulation and inequality; the civil and criminal legal system; the social and cultural contexts of law; legal institutions and professions; and the interactive effects of law and society. With internationally renowned faculty and interdisciplinary perspectives, the program aims to develop students' theoretical and methodological sophistication to prepare them for faculty positions at

name: Criminology, Law and Society Club
description: The purpose of our Criminology, Law and Society Club is to offer a space of similar majors and interests to students who would like to network with others of the same degree aspiration. We want to provide insight, guidance, and services to support students with their classes as well as a pathway for success. Our goal is to allow students to have an open space to collaborate, study, and hear from guest speakers about career opportunities and their experiences within the field. We decided to create this club as there is no environment for Criminology students to gather and support each other.

name: Critical Theory Emphasis
description: To create a community among faculty and students in or interested in the Critical Theory Emphasis at UCI.

name: Cross Youth Initiative at UCI
description: Cross Youth Initiative at UCI is a dynamic collegiate campus group dedicated to reaching and empowering the next generation through a unique blend of faith and sports. Partnering with faith-based youth organizations, we organize spontaneous sports meetups, competitive tournaments, and engaging sports camps for middle and high school students. Our mission is to inspire and mentor youth by combining athletic activities with the teachings of Christ. College students serve as coaches and role models, building meaningful relationships and providing positive guidance. Join us in fostering a communit

name: Cross-Cultural Center
description: The Cross-Cultural Center is committed to fostering the holistic development of students by fostering an affirming and inclusive environment. This space enables students to explore their diverse social identities, cultivate critical awareness, build a socially just community, foster meaningful relationships, and promote lifelong learning beyond their time at UCI.

name: CrossLife College Fellowship
description: To bring Gospel-loving students together to enjoy fellowship and grow in the Word.

name: Crossroads at UCI (formerly Liberty Campus Connect at UCI)
description: To form a community around learning decision-making processes that are based on Biblical wisdom, through Bible study and Jesus-centered relationships.

name: Cru
description: We are Cru, a multiethnic community of students and staff passionate about Jesus. We exist to know God better, grow in our faith together, and show the love of Jesus to the world.

name: Cyber at UCI
description: Cyber@UCI is the premier applied cybersecurity education resource at UCI that focuses on delivering cybersecurity education and awareness to the local community and student population. We accomplish this through organizing and hosting weekly meetings, independent student research, and competitions. We provide a space and community for students, staff, and faculty to experiment and learn about cybersecurity however it pertains to their personal and/or professional interests.

name: Cycling Club at UCI
description: Cycling Club at UCI offers resources so as to assist those interested in pursuing mountain biking or road biking as a competitive club sport, recreation hobby, or healthy life style.

name: D¡tto (K-Pop Dance Class Club)
description: D¡tto is in reference to the transforming copy-cat Pokémon and composition by NJZ (a K-pop group), building a connection to our mission of allowing students to become whoever they want to be and providing a shared space where people can share passion, creativity, and cultural exchange. D¡tto aims to provide new experiences to students wanting to learn how to dance or admire Korean culture. Therefore, this club is built to encourage members to learn, move, and grow together.

name: Data at UCI
description: Established in 2021, Data at UCI aims to promote and grow the field of Data Science: providing resources to students who are interested in data or related fields to succeed in college and in their careers. We provide workshops that provide knowledge to supplement analytical skills needed in the industry and research. We are a student-run organization ultimately dedicated to the community of UCI and Orange County.

name: DCE Activities
description: The UCI Division of Continuing Education (DCE) is dedicated to serving our global student community by providing highly valued, innovative and practical learning experiences that promote personal and professional success at any stage of life. With a commitment to integrity, quality, accountability, and personal leadership, our team fosters an inclusive, collaborative environment to empower and transform the lives of our students and each other.

name: Dean's Ambassadors Council
description: Representing the UCI School of Social Sciences undergraduate students, we strive to promote meaningful interactions between students, faculty, and staff to give back to our Social Sciences community by building a strong progressive environment for our students. Our efforts focus on bringing our community together through various events including: Fall Festivals, Hot Topics Debate, First-Generation Alumni Career Panel, and Dean's Day. In addition, the council operates as the first in-line for assisting in staff events and functions.

name: Delight Ministries at UCI
description: Delight Ministries at UCI exists to be a place where any UCI collegiate woman can come and grow in relationships with others, ask difficult questions, and find a strong community of Christians and non-Christians alike. Delight Ministries at UCI provides an opportunity for the women of UCI to explore their faith in a nonjudgmental and open environment. In addition, Delight Ministries at UCI will provide a variety of service opportunities each semester in order to help and engage UCI campus and the local community. Delight Ministries at UCI hopes to equip the women of UCI to give back through th

description: The purpose of Delta Delta Delta shall be to establish a perpetual bond of friendship among its members, to develop a stronger and more womanly character, to broaden the moral and intellectual life, and to assist its members in every possible way. name: Delta Delta Sigma - Pre-Dental Fraternity
description: The mission of Delta Delta Sigma is to provide students with community service opportunities and guidance towards a career in dentistry. We aspire to help students build a strong professional foundation with real world, hands-on experiences such as clinical volunteering, mission trips, and health fairs. We urge our members to value the necessity of serving those in underserved communities while also reinforcing academic integrity on the road towards dental school. Members will have the opportunity to network with dental students, alumni, dental professionals, and fellow pre-dentals. Delta Delt

description: Delta Epsilon Mu is a professional health-interest fraternity at UCI that provides a dynamic educational and social setting for all undergraduates striving toward goals in human and veterinary medicine, pharmacy, dentistry, optometry, nursing, and other health fields.

name: Delta Gamma
description: Delta Gamma offers to women of all ages a rich heritage; continuity based on sound and tested principals of personal integrity, personal responsibility, and intellectual honesty. The object of this Fraternity shall be to foster high ideals of friendship among college women, to promote their educational and cultural interests, to create in them a true sense of social responsibility and to develop in them the best qualities of character.

name: Delta Lambda Chi
description: Delta Lambda Chi aspires to bond dignified individuals who are dedicated to the values of moral excellence and everlasting sisterhood. As we strive to elicit the highest quality in service, leadership, and academic aptitude, we also commit ourselves to experiences that enhance our character and enrich our minds. The memories we share mark an indelible journey through our college years that is symbolic of loyalty, perseverance, and personal achievement. Delta Lambda Chi, Alpha Chapter. description: Delta Sigma Pi is a professional fraternity organized to foster the study of business in universities; to encourage scholarship, social activity and the association of students for their mutual advancement by research and practice; to promote closer affiliation between the commercial world and students of commerce, and to further a higher standard of commercial ethics and culture and the civic and commercial welfare of the community.

name: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority Inc.
description: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. was founded on January 13, 1913, on the campus of Howard University by twenty-two collegiate women that wanted to use their collective strengths to promote academic excellence and provide assistance to those in need. The Founders of Delta Sigma Theta envisioned an organization committed to sisterhood, scholarship, service, and addressing the social issues of the time. name: Demography and Social Analysis MA Program
description: Demography is the scientific study of human population. Because personal behavior "scales up" into population trends, and population trends "scale down" to impact individuals, demography touches all facets of life. This makes demography a versatile tool for analyzing a broad range of social and economic issues. Irvine's Concentration in Demographic and Social Analysis (DASA) offers graduate training in the practical research skills needed to address analytical problems confronting society, business, government, and the nonprofit sector.

name: Dental Volunteers
description: The purpose of this organization is to provide volunteer opportunities for pre-health students who wish to participate in volunteer opportunities, with a focus on dental. Our audience will include students, underserved children, older adults in nursing homes, and other underserved communities. Through volunteering, we will also teach our volunteers dental knowledge such as tray setup, dental instruments, dental etiquette, clinical photography, dental school preparation, and more.

name: Department of Anatomy & Neurobiology
description: The Department of Anatomy & Neurobiology at UCI School of Medicine is a world-leading neuroscience department where discoveries at the molecular, anatomical and physiological levels are seamlessly integrated to the development of new treatments for neurological diseases.

name: Department of Art History
description: Have you ever looked at a photograph, a painting, a building, a sculpture, or even a billboard advertisement and found it so beautiful or perhaps disturbing that you could not take your eyes off it? While art history is for people who find images compelling and historically important, our program also provides skills that go far beyond the appreciation of art.

name: Department of Biomedical Engineering
description: Inspiring Engineering Minds to Advance Human Health

name: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering
description: The CBE department offers a vibrant academic community for those seeking educational opportunities in chemical and biomolecular engineering. Our mission is to provide a high-quality education in chemical and biological engineering at the undergraduate and graduate levels to prepare future leaders in chemical, material, biochemical and biomedical industries, and academia. CBE faculty expertise is broad, with active research programs spanning a wide range of investigation. name: Department of Comparative Literature
description: Internationally renowned for leadership in the field of continental literary theory, Comparative Literature at UCI today is a place of openness and risk—a spacious department, good for thinking, collectivity, and contestation. Our current interests include the possibilities for engaging in politics broadly speaking, for rethinking the present and unmapping a world that seems to be already mapped through disciplinary structures such as area studies, and for interanimating scholarship, teaching, and activism. name: Department of Earth System Science
description: To contribute through research and teaching to a fundamental scientific understanding of the Earth as a coupled system, to train the next generation of Earth scientists, and to inform and educate policy makers and the public-at-large. We envision a society that understands the impact of human activities on the global environment and the interactions within the Earth system that preserve the habitability of the planet.

name: Department of East Asian Studies
description: The graduate program in East Asian Studies at UC Irvine emphasizes rigorous training in language and textual analysis, with equal attention given to the historical, social, and theoretical dimensions of literary and cultural studies. In addition to more traditional vocabularies of criticism and theory, the curriculum encourages exploration of recent challenges to establish conceptual and methodological frameworks. name: Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology
description: Within the UCI BioSci foundational theme of MIND | BODY | WORLD, the Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology focuses on the WORLD and how the MIND and BODY are embedded in this context. Our department studies the molecular basis of how organisms adapt to the natural world over evolutionary time, and how the resultant biological diversity in organismal function affects present-day ecological processes. name: Department of Economics
description: The PhD program in Economics at UC Irvine prepares students for careers in academia, government, and the private sector. The program typically enrolls 15-20 students each year. The expected time to degree is 5 years. Students are admitted to the PhD program with full funding for five years.

name: Department of English Ph.D. Program
description: The Ph.D. program in English at UCI is the #1 department for literary and critical theory nationally (US News and World Report). The research and teaching of department faculty represents and cuts across a range of fields, historical periods, and methodological approaches. Our graduates have gone on to faculty positions at a range of nationally ranked colleges and universities, including, in recent years, the University of Michigan, Tulane, Rice, Clemson, BYU, and Connecticut College. Many of our PhD faculty and students participate jointly in collaborative, interdisciplinary research clusters

description: Department of Environmental and Occupational Health The mission of the Department of Environmental and Occupational Health (DEOH) in the Program in Public Health (PPH) is to conduct interdisciplinary research and teaching across the fields of exposure science, toxicology, risk assessment, epidemiology, urban health, climate change, natural disasters, environmental health disparity, and related disciplines, to elucidate how environmental exposures in home, community, and occupational settings influence human health and the development and progression of human disease, with the aim of preventing

name: Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics (Epidemiology, M.S./Ph.D.)
description: Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics The mission of the Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics is to improve population health through research, education, community engagement, and translating discoveries into practice. Epidemiology is a quantitative, data-driven discipline that uses rigorous methods to collect, analyze, and interpret health-related data in human populations. Epidemiologists use this information to examine the distribution and determinants of disease and to apply this information to develop disease prevention strategies to improve population health. Epidemiology

name: Department of Gender and Sexuality Studies
description: Since its inception in 1975 as the center of feminist scholarship and teaching at UC Irvine, the Department of Gender & Sexuality Studies has been dedicated to the interdisciplinary study of gender and sexuality in their complex articulations with race, ethnicity, religion, nationality, and socio-economic class. The Department draws critical attention to "gender" and "sexuality" as concept-terms that necessarily invoke multiple systems of oppression, inequality and privilege, and which engender various forms of embodiment, desire, subjectivity, knowledge and politics. We look at masculinities

name: Department of Health, Society, and Behavior & Department of Population Health and Disease Prevention (Public Health, Ph.D.)
description: Department of Health, Society, and Behavior Our department is comprised of a dynamic array of faculty with diverse backgrounds in public health and related fields in the social and biological sciences. Our faculty primarily has expertise in the areas of health behavior, social determinants of health, social epidemiology, health disparities and health equity, community-based research, biobehavioral health, and health communication. Our core values include investigating the etiology of health behavior related processes and outcomes, the dynamics of marginalized populations, community-based resea

name: Department of History
description: The Department History is designed to develop critical intelligence and to foster an awareness of ourselves and our world through the study of the past. The Department presents a variety of approaches to history, and each emphasizes basic disciplinary skills: weighing evidence, constructing logical arguments, and exploring the role of theory in historical analysis and human action.

name: Department of Materials Science and Engineering
description: We are an interdisciplinary and enthusiastic group of faculty and staff who are firmly committed to the success of our students and programs. The field of materials science and engineering sits at the intersection of chemistry, physics and engineering, with increasing expansion into mathematics, computing, machine learning, manufacturing and imaging, plus economics, sustainability and public policy. MSE is the field that enables all other areas of engineering by understanding – and therefore creating – new and exciting materials that enable faster computers, cleaner energy, more efficient auto

name: Department of Philosophy
description: UCI's Philosophy Department is committed to providing students a well-rounded graduate education, including central areas of contemporary philosophy and a solid foundation in the history of philosophy. Those with interests in mathematics, the natural sciences, or the social sciences are encouraged to take courses in Logic and Philosophy of Science and to include LPS faculty members on their dissertation committees. Our cooperative two-track program provides students the benefits of faculty expertise in a host of areas.

name: Department of Sociology
description: The graduate program offers broad training in sociology, with several areas of concentrated expertise: education; family, life course, and sexualities; global inequality and change; immigration; population; organizations, occupations, and labor; social inequality: race/ethnicity, gender, and class/stratification; social movements and political sociology; social networks; organizations, occupations, and labor; and the study of democracy. name: Design at UCI
description: Design at UCI is a community for designers of all skill levels and backgrounds. We provide the resources and space for students to innovate, create, and ultimately grow as designers. Through community, education, and collaboration, we strive to spark and foster creativity in our members and throughout the UCI community.

name: Diabetes Link at UCI
description: The mission of this organization is to create a supportive and stigma-reducing space for students, faculty, staff, and campus affiliates to learn about the complexities of managing diabetes

name: Dialogue Society
description: Guided by the belief that there is always a better version of oneself, Dialogue Society aims to enrich the lives of communities. Our purpose is to educate the community through meaningful dialogues on healthy, purposeful and mindful living—free from promoting political affiliations or religious beliefs—to discover what inspires us towards personal development. We move forward by the motto of "Dialogue. Discover. Develop."

name: DigiFilm Society at UCI
description: The purpose of this organization is to provide students with events catered to enriching their knowledge of filmmaking and expose themselves to professionals working in the industry. We also strive to connect students with resources and each other in order to promote filmmaking at UCI.

name: Disability and Neurodiversity Alliance Plus
description: The Disability and Neurodiversity Alliance Plus is a support and advocacy group of undergraduate students at UC Irvine. We are led by students with disabilities including people who identify as d/Deaf, autistic, and allies of people with disabilities, represented by the “Plus” in our name. We aim to make our club a safe space to destigmatize disability identity and create opportunities for self-advocacy and mutual aid. DNA+ will further raise awareness of accessibility while also creating a campus culture supportive of students with disabilities.

name: Disability Cultural Center
description: The UCI Disability Cultural Center (DCC) serves as a central hub for students and other members of the UCI community with disabilities to foster a sense of belonging, encourage community-building, and create opportunities for mutual aid and self-advocacy. Led by people with disabilities, the DCC aims to raise awareness that destigmatizes disability identity and engenders a campus culture in which disabled people can thrive. The DCC recognizes that disability is part of UCI’s diversity initiative and asserts the importance of disability identity and culture at UCI.

name: Disability Services Center
description: Eliminate, Eradicate, and Obliterate Stereotypical Thinking about Disability. • Provides free and confidential services that are open to all UCI students with disabilities, including international and undocumented students. • Strives to create a culture of inclusion and access in all aspects of student life at UCI. • Challenges and seeks to eliminate stereotypes and myths about disability.

name: Diverse Abilities Inclusion & Support for Youth
description: Diverse Abilities Inclusion & Support for Youth aims at raising awareness about the importance of inclusivity as well as the obstacles that children with diverse disabilities face. In order to achieve this, DAISY works alongside children with various temporary and chronic disabilities, including cognitive and physical conditions, to help improve their quality of life, inspire them to reach their full potentials, and offer a strong network of peers and support.

name: Division of Career Pathways
description: The Division of Career Pathways educates and engages UCI students and alumni to realize their career potential. We do this by: • Coordinating with the campus community in the professional development of students. • Providing students and alumni with tools and support to attain their career goals. • Delivering exceptional customer service to the employer community while recognizing individual recruiting needs.

name: Division of Teaching Excellence and Innovation (DTEI)
description: The Division of Teaching Excellence and Innovation (DTEI) is dedicated to partnering with faculty, graduate students, and postdocs to maximize students' academic success. We accomplish this by cultivating exceptional learning environments across campus through pedagogical development opportunities focused on integrating innovative, evidence-based teaching practices. DTEI's goals align with the Office of the Vice Provost for Teaching and Learning (OVPTL) and Pillar 2 and 4 of the UCI Strategic Plan: 1. Enhance pedagogical training for faculty, graduate students, postdoctoral scholars, and staff

name: Division of Undergraduate Education (DUE)
description: DUE provides leadership, advocacy and coordination for campus initiatives that impact undergraduate education and enhance student access and retention. Working with faculty, the Academic Senate, academic support staff and others, DUE units deliver a wide variety of academic programs and services that support undergraduate teaching and learning campuswide.

name: Doctors Without Borders at UCI
description: We aim to inform and raise awareness among the broader community about global conflicts and ways individuals can support these efforts, whether through fundraising, education, or resource provision. Additionally, our commitment extends to assisting individuals irrespective of their gender, political beliefs, or religious affiliation.

name: Dragon Boat at UC Irvine
description: Dragon Boat at UC Irvine is a team that competes at dragon boat festivals, racing against other college teams and non-college teams. Dragon boat is a sport consisting of twenty paddlers in a long canoe shaped boat, paddling simultaneously. We are heading into our 24th year of existence and have races in San Francisco; Tempe, AZ; Long Beach; San Diego; and even Vancouver. We are a team that strives to exceed expectations in our training and competition. Along with training, our team aims to build strong bonds and create a big family. name: Drainers at UCI
description: At Drainers at UCI, our mission is to foster a safe, inclusive, and vibrant community centered around a shared passion for underground music. We aim to bring together students who seek connection through niche genres and emerging artists, providing a space where they can discover new sounds, express themselves, and build meaningful relationships. In the short term, we strive to cultivate a supportive environment for fans to meet and engage with one another. In the long term, we aspire to grow a lasting network of friendships rooted in a love for underground music and authentic connection.

name: DreamCatchers at UCI
description: DreamCatchers at UCI develops students into compassionate leaders through fostering intergenerational connections between students and older adults, particularly those who are in hospice. These connections are created through acts of service, primarily by fulfilling end-of-life Dreams for hospice patients.

name: Earth System Science Club
description: ESSC is an academic and social club that focuses on providing guidance, professional development opportunities, and a place for students to meet others interested in environmental careers. All majors are welcome!

name: EarthReps - UCI Housing Sustainability
description: EarthReps is a student training and community building internship for undergraduate on-campus residents offering education, skills, and hands-on experiences broadly related to sustainability. EarthReps serve as sustainability ambassadors in student housing. The program aims to train emerging young leaders, expand campus awareness of sustainability, and build community among students, staff, and faculty. name: East African Student Association
description: EASA’s mission is to foster a strong, inclusive community for East African students at UCI by celebrating our cultures, uplifting underrepresented voices, and creating a space where students feel seen, supported, and empowered. We aim to connect students through shared identity and experience, and promote cultural pride through events, dialogue, and mentorship.

name: Echolalia: Undergraduate Literary Journal (formerly Echolalia)
description: Echolalia: Undergraduate Literary Journal's purpose is to create a safe and non-discriminatory environment for all students of University California, Irvine to express their literary voices in an accessible publication. Echolalia will be working to make a difference by providing a resourceful outlet and promoting interests in literature, and creative, as well as academic writing by means of disseminating a publication.

name: Ecology and Evolutionary Club at UCI
description: The purpose of EEB Club is to create a community for those involved in the EEB major or interested in EEB. We will highlight community and volunteer events, resources for students, connect with faculty and peers etc.

description: To provide a community filled with Egyptians or people interested in Egyptian culture. To create a space for Egyptians to meet one another and to create connections here at UCI.

name: End Overdose at UCI
description: Our mission is to make resources that prevent opioid overdoses readily available to the UCI community and beyond, and to raise public awareness of drug-related deaths and how they can be prevented.

name: ENG Office of Outreach, Access, and Inclusion
description: OAI is an office within the Henry Samueli School of Engineering created in 2014 to recruit, retain, and graduate talented students from historically excluded populations who are currently underrepresented in Engineering.

name: Engineering Student Council (ESC)
description: It is the mission of the Engineering Student Council (ESC) at UC Irvine to be a liaison between undergraduate engineering students and the faculty, staff, and administration of The Henry Samueli School of Engineering. ESC serves as the umbrella organization for other Engineering Student Organizations to promote cooperation and build relationships among students. We create networking and research opportunities for students by coordinating events with other organizations, faculty members, and corporations across Southern California. name: Engineering Undergraduate Student Affairs
description: The Engineering Undergraduate Student Affairs office provides a full range of academic counseling services to undergraduate students in our 11 Engineering majors and 2 Engineering minors as well as advising for students interested in changing their major into Engineering. Students are not assigned to specific academic counselors and are free to see any available counselor or Peer Advisors (by appointment or on a walk-in basis) during the office’s open hours.

name: Engineers for a Sustainable World at UCI - ESW
description: Created in 2016, Engineers for a Sustainable World (ESW) at UCI strives to empower young engineers to tackle today’s sustainability challenges. Our organization provides UCI students with career development opportunities, engineering-based skill workshops, and environmental awareness through our weekly general meetings and occasional on and off-campus events. ESW also hosts a variety of student-led projects, open to anyone. Our goal is to give students, regardless of ability, the opportunity to explore hands-on engineering design. We offer a judgement-free zone for project members to learn tea

name: Engineers Without Borders at UCI
description: The purpose of EWB at UCI shall reflect and support the values and mission of Engineers Without Borders-USA: “to partner with disadvantaged communities to improve their quality of life through implementation of environmentally sound and economically sustainable engineering projects, while developing internationally responsible engineering students.”

name: English Majors Association at UCI
description: The English Majors' Association (EMA) works to bring together students and faculty to build a sense of community within the English Department and a support system for current undergraduate students. Although the club is primarily aimed towards students in the English major/minor, we also welcome students from the Literary Journalism and Comparative Literature programs, as well as anyone who is interested in discussing literature! EMA holds regular weekly meetings as well as quarterly events such as Book Swaps, Poetry Events, Open Mic Nights, Research Presentations, and Game Nights.

name: Entertainment and Sports Law Society
description: The Entertainment and Sports Law Society is a student-run organization focused on incorporating business and legal studies involving music, film, fashion, video games, sports, and other industries of interest. Our organization hosts speaker presentations, social events, and provides networking opportunities in an effort to circulate industry information and contacts within the entertainment and sports law sector. The organization will also create a publication informing the UCI Law community about current issues and legal decisions affecting the industry at large.

name: Environmental Law Society at University of California Irvine School of Law

description: FightingGamers@UCI (FG@UCI) is a student organization on the campus of the University of California, Irvine (UCI) for people who have an interest in fighting games. description: The purpose of Figure Skating Club at UCI is to promote the sport of figure skating within the Irvine community and provide ways for its members to progress in and enjoy the sport as a team and as individuals. description: The goal of the Financial Literacy Association shall be to aid undergraduate University of California, Irvine students to make better and more informed decisions regarding the use and management of money.

name: Hospice Care Association at UC Irvine

The goal of ISC is to unite the students of UC Irvine whose cultural roots come from that of the Indian Sub-continent: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. description: The Industry Pharmacy Organization at UCI is dedicated to advancing the careers of industry pharmacists. IPhO at UCI accomplishes this by providing timely and relevant information that is vital to our members. IPhO at UCI also raises awareness among employers and industry executives about the role that industry pharmacists can play in drug development and appropriate medication use. IPhO at UCI provides targeted resources and coaching to enhance members' continuing education and professional development. IPhO at UCI is also critical in creating opportunities for members to network and exchange

name: Information and Computer Sciences
description: The Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences aims for excellence in research and education. Our mission is to lead the innovation of new information and computing technology by fundamental research in the core areas of information and computer sciences and cultivating authentic, cutting-edge research collaborations across the broad range of computing and information application domains as well as studying their economic, commercial and social significance. name: InfrasCtrl at UCI
description: InfrasCtrl at UCI empowers underrepresented, small, and student-run businesses through technology. Our mission is to design and develop free websites that help entrepreneurs build legitimacy, increase visibility, and access financial opportunities such as grants and loans. By combining website design, social media outreach, and community collaboration, we aim to bridge the digital divide and promote equitable access to digital tools.
