description: The Innovation Advisor network is a group of local business leaders who volunteer their time to support the development of the UCI Beall Applied Innovation entrepreneurial ecosystem. The goals of the Innovation Advisor network are to increase the likelihood of success of UCI-affiliated ventures by providing insightful and actionable guidance and mentorship to individuals and teams and to foster engagement between the University and the local entrepreneurial community to accelerate the commercialization of University innovations.

name: Innovative Design at UCI

name: INSA Dance Team
description: INSA dance is an exhibition open choreography dance team based at UC Irvine. Founded in 2008, our mission is to share our passion and love for dance with the public. As a family, we uphold our values and the name, I Never Stand Alone.

name: Institute for Clinical & Translational Science
description: The UC Irvine Institute for Clinical and Translational Science (ICTS) is funded by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) under the Clinical and Translational Sciences Award (CTSA) program. Currently, there are more than 50 medical research institutions throughout the United States that receive CTSA program funding. The ICTS functions as a local centerpiece for the national program, and is dedicated to advancing scientific discovery and medical breakthroughs. Collectively, our goal is simple: to accelerate these discoveries from the lab and translate them into life-altering medical care.

name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers at UCI - IEEE
description: IEEE at UCI is a premier engineering club working at the intersection of electrical engineering, computer engineering, and computer science. We provide a place for those who are interested in both hardware and software to consistently meet and develop their skills and passions with others. There are many ways we do this. One is our lab and community room at ICS 225, and it is open every day. We also host technical and career-focused workshops. name: Institute of Transportation Engineers
description: The Institute of Transportation Engineers is an international educational and scientific association of transportation professionals who are responsible for meeting mobility and safety needs. ITE facilitates the application of technology and scientific principles to research, planning, functional design, implementation, operation, policy development and management for any mode of ground transportation. name: Institute of Transportation Studies Graduate Student Association at UCI - ITSGSA
description: This group serves graduate students who are part of the Institute of Transportation Studies (ITS). The purpose of the group is to provide a social community for graduate students and their families through weekly and quarterly events. The group also hosts welcome events for new students and end of the year events for all faculty, staff, and students of ITS.

name: Intellectual Property Law Society (IPLS)
description: The Intellectual Property Law Society (IPLS) is dedicated to exploring and promoting academic, professional, and industry issues at the intersection of law and intellectual property—including copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and related fields. Through engagement with legal professionals, faculty, and peers, IPLS fosters a dynamic and supportive community for students passionate about intellectual property law.

name: InterAxon at UCI
description: Our mission is to teach students of underserved K-12 Title 1 schools in the Orange County area about Neuroscience and STEM topics. We share our enthusiasm for the brain through our unique lessons and demonstrations. We travel to elementary schools, middle schools, and high schools in disadvantaged areas of Orange County to work with students at schools receiving poor funding in the sciences. Our long term goal is to create and foster interest, excitement, and curiosity about the brain. name: Intercollegiate Athletics/Bren Events Center
description: The Bren Events Center is a full-service, multi-functional venue with a reputation of unparalleled standards for quality service. The cornerstone of its vision is to maintain 100% complete customer satisfaction at every point of contact. The Center strives to create a memorable and enjoyable experience for all of its clients and guests.

name: Interdepartmental Neuroscience Program Graduate Program
description: Competitive INP candidates will have had a substantial subset courses covering the following topic areas: neuroscience, biology, biochemistry, psychology, physics, calculus, and genetics. Preference will be given to applicants who have had laboratory research experience. We encourage all well qualified applicants to apply, as we're a very competitive program !

name: Interfraternity Council (IFC)
description: The Interfraternity Council (IFC) serves as the self-governing body for the fraternities at the University of California Irvine. It consists of the Executive Board and the Council. The executive board consists of fraternity members who are elected into their positions by the IFC Council. The Council consists of presidents and delegates from each chapter. Every Monday of the academic year the executive board and council convene for formal IFC meeting at 11 am in the Dr. White Room in the Cross-Cultural Center.

name: International Law Forum
description: The International Law Forum at the University of California, Irvine seeks to foster an engaged community of students passionate about global governance, law, and justice. Our mission is to promote scholarly dialogue and collaboration on issues of international law, politics, and policy by providing students with a platform to research, publish, and debate emerging global legal challenges. name: International Law Society at UCI - ILS
description: The International Law Society (ILS) at UCI is a forum for discussing topics in international law. ILS seeks to contribute to the academic dialogue at UCI and among other law schools through collaborative events, clinical work, and a supportive curriculum.

name: International Student Excellence Programs

description: ISG is an official Christian student group at UC Irvine. We welcome all students: undergraduate and graduate, Christian and non-Christian, and especially international students. The students in our group come from many countries around the world, including the United States. Our mission is to "love locally, impact globally," in which we seek to create a "home away from home" for students studying in Irvine. name: International Student Mentorship Program at UCI
description: The purpose of this organization shall be to support international students to thrive during their studies and equip them with life and leadership skills needed to be successful beyond graduation. This is accomplished through mentorship with professional volunteers, workshops led by experienced industry professionals, English conversation sessions, and relationship-building events that help students navigate academic life, cultural adjustment, and career transitions while building a supportive community.

name: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF)
description: We are a student-led movement committed to actively pursuing Jesus Christ as a witnessing community.

description: Iranian Student Union is a campus organization at the University of California, Irvine. With UCI located in the most heavily populated Persian community outside of Iran, we hope to spread awareness of our traditions through cultural and social events. name: Irvine Barclay Theatre
description: The mission of Irvine Barclay Theatre is to be a leading cultural presenter featuring the work of diverse and exceptional artists and providing a state-of-the-art venue for community cultural organizations and university programs, thus broadening the scope, availability and appreciation of the performing arts in Orange County.

name: Irvine Chess Club
description: Hello! We're the Irvine Chess Club. Join us to meet and play with fellow chess players from UCI! Beginners, intermediate players, and experts are all welcome. Our purpose is to create a space where creativity, collaboration, and ambition come together to help students turn their ideas into reality within the music industry. description: The Japanese Student Association at UCI is a multicultural social club dedicated to the exchange of Japanese and American cultures. Here, students have the opportunity to make new intercollegiate friends, celebrate the extensive world of Japanese culture, and even access career opportunities in Japan.

Our mission is to foster the art of improvisational jazz dance, nurturing creativity, and igniting the joy of movement among our members. description: JHOP is the contending House of Prayer for the UCI campus and the city of Irvine. We believe that prayer is key to seeing God move in our personal lives and our community. We can't do anything apart from God, and through prayer, we learn to abide in and partner with Him. Our long-term vision is to establish a 24-7 house of prayer and worship in Irvine from which evangelism and outreach will flow.

description: MISSION STATEMENT The Jewish Law Association (JLA) is dedicated to: -Facilitating meaningful connections between Jewish law students -Organizing events for the benefit of the membership and the law school community as a whole -Fostering outreach with the Orange County Jewish legal community -Exploring the unique legal and cultural aspects of Judaism -Providing opportunities for tikkun olam (social action) Membership is open to all current law students, regardless of individual religious affiliation.

description: Jodaiko is a collegiate taiko group from the main campus of the University of California, Irvine. Now in its 35th year since inception, Jodaiko brings the Japanese art of taiko to UCI and the rest of Southern California. The word "Jodaiko" means "passionate drumming" in Japanese, and as a collegiate taiko group, each member must balance their passion for taiko with their desire to pursue an education. Jodaiko takes pride in the diverse cultures, areas of study, and performance experiences each member represents.

name: Judo Club at UCI
description: Our mission is to promote the art of Judo by fostering physical fitness, mental discipline, and camaraderie, while cultivating respect, resilience, and continuous personal growth within a supportive university community.

Jugger at UCI will engage in community outreach to foster engagement and engage students for tournaments and events held around the U.S.

The Kendo Club at UCI aims to instill training of the body, mind, and personal character through the "way of the sword." Students will learn, train, and compete in intercollegiate tournaments through the Kendo Club at UCI.

(2) Enable students to help one another reach their education/career goals through various academic and emotional support. description: The purpose of the Labor and Work Law Society is to educate members in labor and employment law, as well as the advocate’s role in furthering the advancement of workers’ rights; to provide union, plaintiff, and management-side networking opportunities to members; to provide space for reflection on the relationship between labor and oneself; and to engage in solidarity through action to advocate for the dignity of all workers.

name: Lambda Phi Nu
description: Founded at UCI, Lambda Phi Nu is a co-ed business leadership fraternity dedicated to igniting leaders, illuminating communities, and inspiring legacies on and off campus. description: Lambda Theta Delta is the only officially recognized Asian American interest fraternity at the University of California Irvine. Since its inception at the University of California, Irvine over three decades ago, Lambda Theta Delta has initiated over 1000 members and has become one of the most influential local student organizations in Southern California. description: The Land Use and Real Estate Society is dedicated to fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment for students interested in the legal frameworks that shape real estate law, real estate development, and land use regulation. Through speaker events, networking sessions, and career-focused workshops, we expose students to the diverse pathways available within real estate law—from transactional work and litigation to zoning and urban planning. Our mission is to equip future attorneys with the knowledge, connections, and confidence to thrive in a complex and evolving legal landscape.

name: Language and Linguistics Club (formerly Syntax PROs)
description: The mission of Language and Linguistics Club is to expose members of the UC Irvine community to the beauty and science of language and its interactions with culture and history. We seek to create an open space for students to discuss any topics in the field of linguistics, from their social impacts to the underlying syntactic structures. The events associated with our club will emphasize linguistic and cultural diversity as well as an increased awareness of the underlying grammatical structures and features of languages other than English.

description: The Latino Business Student Association is a student-run non-profit organization established in 2003. The organization accomplishes this by focusing on its three pillars: Professional Development, Social Interaction, and Community Service, with a foundation on Academic Achievement.

Our mission is to confront these issues through community service, mentorship, coalition building, and networking.

name: Lebanese Student Association (formerly Lebanese Social Club)
description: The goal of this club is to: A. To promote the interests of the Lebanese and non-Lebanese students at UC Irvine. B. To acquaint the UCI community with Lebanon and the Lebanese people, and to promote their culture. C. To help Lebanese students integrate better into the diverse UCI community by creating an atmosphere of friendship & support. D. To form a closely knit community on campus.

name: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender Resource Center (LGBTRC)
description: The UCI Lesbian Gay Bisexual Transgender Resource Center provides a wide range of education and advocacy services supporting intersectional identity development. We foster community, wellness, an open and inclusive environment for lesbian, gay, bisexual, intersex, transgender, queer, asexual, ally, and questioning students, faculty, staff, and the larger campus community. We strive to develop an atmosphere of acceptance and wellbeing in which the campus community can support the academic mission of the university.

name: Leukemia and Lymphoma Society at UCI
description: The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society at UCI is a chapter of the national organization dedicated to curing leukemia, lymphoma, Hodgkin’s disease and myeloma, and improving the quality of life of patients and their families. LLS at UCI’s mission is to provide a forum for discussion, education, awareness, funding, and support of our shared interest in making an impact in the fight against blood cancer. As well as to provide a place to participate in various interactions such as; service, advocacy efforts, education, fundraising and facilitating events tailored to our organizational interests.

name: LikeLion at UCI

With the vast library of online LikeLion lectures, we are planning to provide lessons on various fields of coding, including python, java, and UI-UX and general front-end coding. For the members with prior coding background, we will push them to develop projects in a real-world settings to prepare them for the tech industry.

name: Live Action at UCI (formerly Anteaters For Life)
description: The purpose of Live Action at UCI will be to defend the rights of the most vulnerable in society. The short term goals will be to engage all UCI students with a passion for advocating for life, and to educate students that all life is valuable and needs to be protected from the moment of conception. We aim to make sure the womb remains the safest place anyone could be. The long term goals will be to continue to provide opportunities and resources for all UCI students interested in respectfully engaging in advocating for the lives of the unborn.

name: Living Stone Christian Fellowship

Each year of LSF has a different flavor, contributed by each person's unique story, gifts, pain, brokenness, and dreams. But our focus on Jesus remains the same. We envision LSF to be a safe space for college students (including seekers with questions about faith) to grow in identity, character, and life purpose via experiencing Christ-centered community.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have questions.

description: Punjabis at UC Irvine (PAI) exists to celebrate and promote the rich heritage of Punjabi culture. Our purpose is to create a vibrant community for individuals who share a passion for Punjabi traditions, language, and values. Through a variety of events, educational programs, and cultural activities, we aim to raise awareness and foster appreciation for Punjabi culture within our community and beyond.

name: Pyo Alliance of Community Health and Education at UCI
description: Our mission is to unite premed students with a passion for community service, fostering a commitment to healthcare, volunteerism, and professional growth. Through hands-on service projects, volunteering, & public health initiatives, we strive to make a meaningful impact on underserved communities while preparing our members for careers in medicine. By combining education, outreach, and collaboration, we aim to make ourselves into compassionate future healthcare professionals dedicated to service and advocacy.

name: QT STEM
description: QT STEM is an organization at UCI for queer and/or trans people who are part of the STEM fields. With this group, we hope to create a more visible LGBTQ+ community in what can be an underrepresented area of academia. We also encourage allies to join! However, LGBTQ+ voices and experiences will be centered. As a campus organization, we work to build support systems and connections to resources for LGBTQ+ people at the all levels of the campus community (undergraduate, graduate, postdoctoral, technicians, staff, faculty) in STEM fields. name: Quantum Computing Club at UCI
description: At the Quantum Computing Club, we’re all about unlocking the power of quantum software and building a vibrant quantum community at UCI! Whether you're a total beginner or already dreaming in qubits, we’re here to help you design, experiment, and innovate with real quantum algorithms. But we don’t stop there! We love crossing boundaries—from machine learning to optimization and beyond—exploring how quantum computing can revolutionize different fields. name: Queer & Asian at UCI - Q&A
description: Queer & Asian at UCI (Q&A) is an organization focused on the intersections of LGBTQ+, Asian, and Pacific Islander (API) identities. This group exists to engender a space, where Q&A identified individuals can share resources, find community, and peer support.

name: Raíces Dentales de UCI
description: Foster academic, professional, and personal growth through mentorship, networking, and skill-building opportunities. Promote cultural pride and representation within the dental field. Educate members about dental school preparation, community service, and oral health awareness. Collaborate with local dental professionals and organizations to provide outreach and volunteering opportunities.

name: Rang De Irvine
description: Rang De Irvine is the only Bhangra team at UCI. Bhangra is a dance that originated in Punjabi known for its very high energy and colorful performances. Our team has been around for 3 years and we have performed at competitions as far as Davis, CA and are previous reigning champions of Soulstice (UCI's annual talent show). We are open to a variety of experience levels; even if you have never tried bhangra before come join us at one of the future workshops! We are so excited to meet all of you and have you be a part of our bhangra family!

name: REACH at UCI
description: REACH at UCI's mission is to empower aspiring creators, marketers, and social media enthusiasts by connecting them with professional opportunities, and providing a space for those interested in the social media or marketing field to collaborate with one another and grow professionally.

name: ReachOut TeachOut at UCI
description: The mission of this initiative is to strengthen existing partnerships, in addition to fostering new collaborations, between high school science programs and UCI research labs. Additionally, we seek to help graduate students sharpen their science communication and teaching skills. Altogether, we hope to inspire young students to pursue careers in science, and ultimately, help to increase their preparedness for college-level study. Our vision is that these efforts will lead to the University and the scientific enterprise overall becoming more accessible to the community at large.

name: Real Estate Association at UCI- REA
description: Real Estate Association is an undergraduate student organization with the purpose of bringing together a community of students at UCI that is interested in the field of real estate. Open to all majors and backgrounds, our club provides opportunities for undergraduates to learn more about real estate, develop their leadership and professional skills, and to further their passion for service to the community. We also promote student awareness of the potential career opportunities in the field of real estate by connecting our members to professionals in different aspects of the real estate indust

name: Reformed University Fellowship
description: RUF is a Christian ministry for UCI students to come and explore together who Jesus is. We want his life, death, and resurrection to shape our friendships, our thinking, and our campus.

name: Reframing Civil and Environmental Engineering at UCI - CEER
description: CEER is a coalition of undergraduate students, graduate students and postdocs from UCI CEE working to promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) both within our department and the university as a whole. We formed this group because we sensed a gap in the discussion and education of social, environmental, political, and economic issues within the department's curriculum, and desire to ensure that the department's Anti-Racism Task Force is making progress toward shaping a school where students feel fully represented. We are committed to working with CEE Department leadership to achieve our g

name: Regents Scholar Society at UCI
description: Regents Scholar Society at UCI is dedicated to cultivating a community of scholars who embody academic excellence, meaningful service, and transformative leadership. Through mentorship, academic resources, and leadership opportunities, we empower our members to grow, succeed, and thrive — on campus and beyond UCI — while making a lasting impact in their communities. We also strive to create a healthy, and welcoming environment for all members, and for those who are just coming into UCI.

name: Repair Cafe at UCI
description: The mission of the Repair Cafe at UCI is to provide UCI students with the opportunity to utilize their technical skills to help the local community repair their broken items, with the ultimate goal of reducing waste and promoting sustainable consumption in Orange County. This includes electronics, clothing, bicycles, furniture, and much more. UCI students will also have the opportunity to learn new skills from other volunteers through technical workshops, who bring their own diverse talents and experiences to the Repair Cafe.

name: Research Outreach at UCI
description: We are a 100% student-led, peer-support organization focused on connecting undergraduate students to research opportunities at UCI. The organization aims to support students of all majors and interests by conducting skill-based workshops and connecting with labs from all over campus. The primary goal is to introduce students to the many labs and projects at UCI and guide them in joining a lab that their interests match with. Students who are new to research will have the opportunity to navigate the field of research through peer-mentorship from Officers and other members as well as through our

name: Resist US-Led War at UCI
description: The mission of Resist US-Led War at UCI is to raise the political consciousness of students at UCI around issues of militarism and build community support for those who have been impacted by US militarism.

name: REV Auto Car Club
description: As a car club at the University of California, Irvine, REV Auto Car Club aims to build a community for car enthusiasts to gather and share their collective knowledge about automobiles and motorsports. Our goals include teaching members about various aspects of automotive knowledge while constructing a network to develop strong connections in the automotive industry. We also strive to create a safe environment for car enthusiasts by promoting safe driving habits and highly discouraging street racing. REV @ UCI also gives back to the community by hosting public events, such as car shows and food

name: Right To Know (formerly Right To Know Peer Educators)
description: The mission of the Right to KNOW is to raise awareness throughout the UCI community about the widespread occurrence of sexual assault and to promote activities and attitudes that will contribute to the elimination of sexual violence. Central to the group's purpose is the examination of factors that contribute to sexual assault.

name: Rotaract at UC Irvine
description: Rotaract at UCI is a branch of Rotary International, an International Service Organization focused on providing aid and services to different people all over the globe. Rotaract is built with close-knit young professionals who are interested in professional development, international and community based service.

name: Rubik's Cube Club at UCI
description: The Rubik’s Cube Club at UCI aims to foster an inclusive twisty puzzle community on campus by providing resources to collect, solve, and improve their speedcubing skills. We aim to organize World Cube Association (WCA) competitions to make the experience accessible to the Irvine community.

name: Running Club at UCI
description: This is a club for people who enjoy running, whether it's for competitive or recreational/fitness-oriented purposes. We engage in a wide variety of running disciplines and welcome all skill levels. Social events, practices, competitions, fundraisers, volunteer events, and more will be held year-round for members to bond with each other and create their own amazing experiences!

name: Russian Club at UCI
description: Our mission is to create a supportive network for students interested in Russian language and culture, facilitating connections and friendships that extend beyond the classroom.

name: Sailing Club at UCI
description: Sailing Club at UCI will continue to compete in the local, regional, national, and international arenas of collegiate sailing. Our goal is to promote a high level of competition and the opportunity for leadership and team commitment. We also strive to preserve this program's reputation, tradition, and excellence since its founding.

name: Saturday Academy of Law at UCI School of Law
description: The Saturday Academy of Law at UCI School of Law is a pipeline program designed to introduce the legal profession and higher education to ninth-grade students from underrepresented communities. UCI undergraduate students have the opportunity to work as Teaching Assistants with the program.

name: Saudi Student Association at UCI (formerly The Saudi Students Club at UCI)
description: The mission of the Saudi Student Association encompasses two primary objectives: 1- Fostering unity within our community and extending support to all our members. 2- Promoting awareness and understanding of our national culture and traditions.

name: Scholars of Finance
description: Scholars of Finance seeks to prepare UCI students for their careers through self-reflection, values-based development, and mentoring with experienced professionals. We envision a world where our future business leaders distinguish right from wrong and carry themselves through their careers with righteous, principled conduct.

name: Scholarship Opportunities Program
description: The Scholarship Opportunities Program (SOP) works toward UCI's mission to encourage high-achieving undergraduates to compete successfully for the most prestigious scholarships, grants, and graduate fellowships available, and to begin learning about the process as early as possible. name: School of Education
description: The UCI School of Education mission is to improve access to high-quality educational opportunities for all individuals in our university, community and beyond. We are dedicated to producing responsive and innovative cutting-edge research, program design and a next generation of educators that will contribute to a transformational shift in education. We are committed to ensuring that all students are empowered and prepared to lead successful and productive lives and careers in a democratic society.

name: School of Education | Ph.D. in Education
School of Education Student Affairs Office
description: The School of Education's Office of Student Affairs provides student-centered educational support and resources to empower undergraduate and graduate students within the School of Education to achieve academic and personal success.

name: School of Engineering - Graduate and Professional Studies
description: The UCI Samueli School of Engineering educates more than 4,600 students with an integrative approach that blends fundamentals, research and hands-on experience. The school's aim is to unleash innovation, create opportunities and inspire ingenuity. The Samueli School's faculty members are leaders in their disciplines who have achieved worldwide recognition for their research and dedicated teaching. The school offers both research based and experiential professional masters programs. description: Academic Advising Office for the School of Humanities

name: School of Pharmacy & Pharmaceutical Sciences
description: Be a driving force for advancing health and wellness of individuals and society, through innovative and integrative learner-centered education; cutting-edge pharmaceutical research and discoveries; and leadership in inter-professional patient-centered healthcare.

name: School of Physical Sciences
description: Our aim is to deliver scientific breakthroughs that reshape our understanding of the physical world and provide solutions to the most profound problems of our age. We achieve this by asking hard questions; setting inspiring, visionary goals; and cultivating an inclusive, interdisciplinary culture that is open to broad ideas.

name: School of Social Ecology
description: Science-driving solutions

name: School of Social Sciences
description: To create positive change in society, economies and for human well-being by breaking down traditional barriers and pushing the limits in teaching, research and service.

name: School on Wheels at UCI
description: The mission of School on Wheels at UCI is to provide educational support and resources to K-12 students experiencing homelessness within the local community. The organization aims to bridge educational gaps by offering tutoring, mentorship, and academic guidance to students who face significant barriers to learning.

name: Schrödinger's Cast: 30 Plays in 60 Minutes
description: 30/60 is a theatre collective that strives to create truthful, impactful, and experimental theatre in the Neo-Futurist style. Twice a quarter, we perform 30 original plays within the span of 60 minutes, and each performance is unique, meaning no play shall be performed twice. Our shows are committed to artists bringing their true selves to their works, rather than a character or story, as well as bringing the CTSA community together to share the whirlwind experience of being “right here, right now”.

name: Science Olympiad at UC Irvine
description: Our mission is to provide STEM resources and learning opportunities for K-12 students while developing our community members.

name: Scripted Mystery & Immersive Roleplay Society at UCI
description: Providing a communication bridge for students.

name: Sigma Chi (Sig)
description: The purpose of Sigma Chi is a simple one: to help good men become great men by giving them opportunities to build and live their ideals, serve in leadership positions, and engage in positive interaction with those of all temperaments, talents, and convictions, people from all walks of life and backgrounds. The fundamental purpose of the Sigma Chi Fraternity is the cultivation, maintenance and accomplishment of the ideals of friendship, justice, and learning within our membership. name: Sigma Eta Pi - SEP
description: Sigma Eta Pi is a premier co-educational entrepreneurship professional fraternity at UCI, dedicated to fostering a community of passionate and driven innovators and entrepreneurs. Those who have been chosen to join the organization shall preserve and honor the code of the organization and carry forward the values that we hold. Sigma Eta Pi is dedicated to developing human potential by transforming individuals into entrepreneurs who follow their passion, developing lasting connections in the university startup ecosystem, and creating impact through innovative ventures.

name: Sigma Gamma Tau at UCI
description: The mission of Sigma Gamma Tau is to recognize academic and professional excellence in engineering, more notably aerospace engineering. This organization seeks to not only award national recipients but also connect with endeavoring students in engineering to strengthen the academic community and provide opportunities for personal and professional development at UCI and beyond.

name: Wayfinder Incubator
description: Wayfinder is a highly structured incubator, through UCI Beall Applied Innovation, that connects UC-affiliated startups with essential resources needed to launch, grow and succeed. Housed inside the Cove @ UCI, our collaborative team of business leaders, entrepreneurs, investors and technology transfer experts eat, sleep and drink innovation. Using our combined experience, we help fine-tune a strategic process that leads innovation with both commercial promise and the potential to meet real needs, from formation to funding.
